description:
You are an IT security analyst conducting a quarterly user access review for your organization's Nuxeo document management system. An 'Access Review Policy' note in the Templates workspace describes the correct permission assignments for each workspace.

Your task is to:
1. Review the Access Review Policy to understand the required permission model
2. Revoke all access for user 'dpatel' (Deepak Patel), who has departed the organization, across all workspaces
3. Downgrade any overly broad permissions that violate the principle of least privilege (as specified in the policy)
4. Create a new user group called 'iam-auditors' for the security audit team
5. Grant the 'iam-auditors' group Read-only access to all workspaces for ongoing compliance monitoring
6. Add an audit trail comment to each workspace where permissions were modified, documenting the changes made
7. Upload the access review report template from the Desktop (/home/ga/Desktop/access_review_report.csv) to the Templates workspace as a record of the completed audit

Login credentials: Administrator / Administrator
